question: With the camera drain that the phone met on every Night 2 in the model, how often does the device loop -- which answers each broken system with the reboot fnaf3-run.mjs chooseReboot picks, held in the menu until it ends -- still reach 6 AM?
modelChanges: sim-fnaf3.js drains the camera: each 1000 ms with a screen up adds one to `camera text` AV5 and at 12 the camera loses AI points (g783/g784); at -10 the feed shows no room (g381). A camera reboot restores it (g428); reboot all also zeroes AV5 (g430) and ticks every 2000 ms (g426).
The office drain now counts seconds (g906-g908): ventilation drains only after 10 s off the monitor, where the table had 10 frames.

The lure (g299, g301, g317-g352): 10.5 s of play-counter cooldown, AI audio points per play, Random(7) with a 1 failing, and the lure table's adjacency; the policy's lure knobs are off by default because, at 400 seeds, neither herding (Nightmare 267/400) nor a lure on cam 02 when he is lost near the office (261/400) moved the result off the no-lure 265/400.
policy: policy-fnaf3.js trackingLoop({ economy: true }): the device-paced tracking loop; a video or ventilation error sends it ~3.5 s to the menu, it reboots what chooseSimReboot picks (two broken systems or a camera counter 7 s along take reboot all), stays until the reboot ends, and takes ~2.4 s back; a look during a video error sees nothing.
family: fixed-pace belief tracking over the corrected graph with the camera economy; no lures, no phantoms (their scares, the white flash and its blackout are not modelled)
findings: The camera drain is the largest single cost the earlier census did not see: the same loop that held Nightmare on 99.2% without it holds 69% with it, because every 24 s of looking buys a trip of ~12-16 s away from the monitor.

Night 2 at 91% is the model's ceiling for this loop family with its camera economy, before phantoms; the phone's Night 2 losses so far (n2a-n2d) were each traced to something this model now has or that the loop now answers (the seal charge, audio, phantoms, the white flash).
notMeasured: Phantoms and their white flash (g686/g687/g744/g745 -> g704: ventilation to -10 and the blackout past the chain threshold).
Whether the phone's looks, seals and trips cost what the policy's knobs say beyond the n2a-n2d event logs they were read from.
